subject: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping
messages:
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sara@altologs.com
Date: 2026-07-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

Team — kicking off the weekly fleet sprint checkpoint. Goal: reconcile committed/expected deal starts for the next 90 days with provisioning windows and incremental GPU purchases (A100 vs H100), then produce a 30/60/90 day procurement ask for finance.

Current asks from me:
- Sales: confirm firm start dates + close probability for deals > $75k ARR (we already have DL-5489 for AltoLogs).
- Infra: share lead times for provisioning by instance/GPU type and availability windows (region us).
- Finance: give guidance on what a procurement ask should include (CAPEX vs commit discounts).

I'll attach the latest commit matrix; please update row entries for any changes. We'll meet Thursday at 11am PT for a quick readout.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-27T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

Markus — 2 quick infra datapoints after the capacity scrub this morning:
- On-demand pool: we can cover short bursts up to 24 A100-80GB equivalents in us-west next 2 weeks; H100 capacity is limited (we have 4 immediate H100 slots).
- Lead times: procuring additional H100-equivalent nodes for Dedicated (to hit 8 extra H100s) is ~6-8 weeks from PO to availability for our vendor pipeline. A100 replenishment (if we buy add-on pods) is ~3-4 weeks.

Notes: KV cache partitioning for large-chat workloads increases effective utilization; we recommend pairing AltoLogs' profile (long contexts) with prefetched KV cache on A100 where possible to avoid H100 spend.

I'll update the fleet_capacity_impact.xlsx tabs with the above and include a worst-case provisioning timeline.

—Karthik
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-28T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

Thanks — a few finance constraints to keep in mind:
1) For Dedicated we need a minimum ARR commitment to amortize the procurement; recommend deals >= $120k ARR or multi-quarter commits.
2) If infra needs immediate burst capacity we can sign a gated short-term spot contract but we need straight-line cost estimates and an approved vendor list to sign quickly.
3) Please include expected activation month in the matrix (month/year). That helps us model cash flow and depreciation.

If we intend to send a procurement request by the first week of August, I need: the line item list, estimated vendor lead-times (Karthik provided good initial figures), and the expected revenue recognition schedule for each deal.

—Laura
Finance Manager, Revenue Ops
From: Sara Lim <sara@altologs.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-29T13:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

Hi Markus / Marissa — going to confirm AltoLogs' initial ask so you can map it to provisioning:
- Expected go-live: 2026-09-15 (internal deadline).
- Expected committed monthly consumption: ~14 A100-80GB equivalent GPU-hours per minute of concurrency (their SRE translated to ~10 steady concurrent workers).
- Preferred model profile: 70% long-context chat (24k tokens), 30% short-embed/rerank. H100 would be nice for peak inference but AltoLogs is flexible if you can stage on A100 with KV caching.

Procurement contact is ProcureOps (procure@altologs.com) and they'll share the PO template once we finalize pricing.

Thanks — Sara
VP of Platform, AltoLogs Inc.
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 01:35 PM Sara Lim <sara@altologs.com> wrote:
> Hi Markus / Marissa — going to confirm AltoLogs' initial ask so you can map it to provisioning:
> - Expected go-live: 2026-09-15 (internal deadline).
> - Expected committed monthly consumption: ~14 A100-80GB equivalent GPU-hours per minute of concurrency...
>
Thanks Sara — that helps. Quick infra notes:
- To hit a 2026-09-15 activation for AltoLogs we need a provisioning decision by 2026-08-10 to queue H100 procurement. If we decide to stage on A100 with KV caching instead, we can meet the date with an internal reallocation and minor scaling (~2-3 additional A100 pods) and a 2-week runway.
- Recommendation: for Q3 ramp, approve a hybrid approach: permit 4-week burst H100 booking (contracted partner capacity) for initial 8 weeks while we ship 4 additional A100 pods (cheaper, faster). That reduces up-front CAPEX and preserves performance for long-context workloads.
- Action: need final deal ids and whether AltoLogs will sign a 12-month commit or a 6-month pilot by 2026-08-06.

—Vivek
Director, Platform Engineering
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sara@altologs.com
Date: 2026-08-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleet sprint capacity checkpoint: pipeline-to-provision mapping

Good thread — summary + actions (for Thursday readout and finance prep):
1) AltoLogs (DL-5489-ALTO) — expected start 2026-09-15; likely prefer H100 for peaks but will accept A100 + KV cache staging. Marissa: confirm sales price and whether we can convert to 12-month commit by Aug 6.
2) Infra ask: Karthik/Vivek to produce two procurement scenarios in fleet_capacity_impact.xlsx: (A) hybrid burst H100 + 4x A100 pods (recommended), (B) full H100 procurement (CAPEX heavy). Include lead-times and burn-rate tables.
3) Finance: Laura please assemble an August procurement ask template showing NPV over 12 months, CAPEX breakdown, and proposed vendor list.
4) Short-term: approve spot-burst contract up to 4 weeks if needed; mark cost center as "pilot runway" and charge back to AltoLogs pending PO.

Attachments: updated deal_commit_matrix.csv (filled columns); fleet_capacity_impact.xlsx (scheduling tab updated).

I'll push a brief slide to the drive before the Thursday sync — please review the spreadsheet and leave comments by Wednesday EOD.

Thanks,
Markus
